subject.why: The golden hourglass is complete, tilted, and instantly recognizable with the requested blue sand and star accents.

category.why: It floats freely in the air with no floor or table, tilted in three-quarter view, against concentric rings centered on a saturated background.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The hourglass is well-centered with ample, balanced breathing room on all sides.

colour.why: Vibrant warm red background contrasts sharply with the gold frame and saturated blue sand.

detail.why: The forms are bold and simple with clean embossed stars and no distracting micro-textures or clutter.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D forms with a soft satin sheen that match the game's established style.
